title: Engineering feed
description: What the engine reads from linker-commerce: GET /wp-json/linker/v1/engineering-feed (docs/specs/8-engineering-data.md, target shape 5). One entry per published product. The top-level facts are the #7 SelectionFactSet (docs/specs/7-selection-facts.md), produced by its single implementation in linker-commerce, so the engine never re-derives them; `figures` are the cited datasheet values the engine needs beyond those facts, units as stored (the engine converts by `unit`). A figure without a citation to a document we host does not enter the feed.

compatibility_version.description: Content version of the current Woo-maintained compatibility projection, or missing when its declaration envelope is invalid.

compatibility.description: Current Woo-maintained compatibility declarations and product/document bindings. Consumers validate the projection against compatibility.schema.json. Absent when the Woo declaration envelope is invalid; a shipped JSON file is not a maintenance authority.

overlay.description: Reference engineering inputs generated from current Woo engineering-reference records and bound evidence. The migration JSON is not a runtime authority. Empty while no reference is published and prepared.

model.description: pa_model; compatibility patterns are matched against it.

series.description: pa_series (#8 target shape 2); null until assigned.

device_class.description: Slug of the product's primary product category.

kwh_range.description: A stated energy range (for example 57.3-100.3 kWh) that #7 keeps out of the scalars.

figures.description: Figure key -> cited value. Keys the engine reads are listed in docs/specs/8-engineering-data.md target shape 1.

qualifier.description: The condition as maintained in Woo. It is evidence to interpret, never an automatically satisfied engineering predicate.

columns.description: Explicit table column labels maintained with the Woo figure. Column order or model names alone never establishes a configuration mapping.

doc.description: Original source-document label, retained as provenance. Permission requires the cited hosted URL and current Woo evidence; the label does not authorize use.

aliases.description: Explicit hosted aliases of this versioned document, still subject to current source-product permission.

lang.description: Producer-normalized language: a lowercase two-letter language, mul for explicitly multilingual material, und when unstated or unrecognized. Woo's editorial value remains unchanged; unknown does not imply English or German.

hostedUrl.description: Every document is a file we host (owner ruling 2026-09-02).
